title: Horror Movie Poster with Cast and Title
coreRelationships: The faces of the four individuals are tightly cropped and angled, creating a sense of unease and direct engagement with the viewer.
The dark background and lighting emphasize the faces, drawing attention to their expressions of concern or fear.
The stylized title typography is integrated into the lower half of the image, with elements like the knife and the shadowy figure adding to the horror theme.
The color palette is dominated by dark tones, with skin tones and red accents providing contrast and highlighting key elements.
reuseFormula: Recreate the dark, high-contrast portrait composition with dramatic lighting. Integrate custom-designed, distressed typography for the main title, featuring jagged edges, metallic textures, and a sharp graphic element. Use a distressed serif for the subtitle. Place a shadowy figure and background cracks to enhance the horror theme. Maintain a limited, dark color palette with red and cool blue accents.
